text:
noah_sales: FYI — Solaris Health requesting an exception: 40% off Redwood Dedicated (12mo), net-60, and extended observability retention. Deal exec says mandatory migration by June. Need quick internal ok to avoid losing the renew.

marta_finance: Can you drop the headline numbers? ARR, discount $ impact, and cost assumptions? We need margin delta to pass to FP&A.

noah_sales: Sure — roughs:
- List price (12mo reserved): $480k ARR
- Requested 40% off => $192k discount => committed ARR $288k
- Observability retention add-on: +$24k
- Net-60 requested (usual is net-30)
We estimate cost of goods (GPU + infra + infra-support) ~ $120k/yr for this pool. Margin goes from ~75% to ~46% with discount.

marta_finance: Oof. That's material. Can you share customer strategic justification? Is this a logo win or reference case? Any chance for shorter term commitment or lower discount tier?

noah_sales: Customer is large regional provider, potential for expansion into Private deployments and references in EU. They want price parity with competitor X who quoted 35% + net-60. They asked for 12 months to match procurement cycles.

kevin_dealdesk: For discounts >30% we need Deal Desk approval + legal signoff on terms. Also need revenue ops to approve deferred revenue recognition for net-60. @ada_fp&a please weigh in on exposure.

ada_fp&a: I'll run exposure calc. Quick note: if we accept net-60 we carry $288k AR risk for 30 extra days => cashflow hit estimate ~ $23k interest-equivalent at our discount rate. Also need to mark as special terms in Salesforce for audit.

sam_legal: On net-60 and observability retention, propose these conditions:
1) Add early-pay incentive (1.5% if paid within 15 days).
2) No custom indemnities. Standard T&C only.
3) Add clause: discount clawback if customer reduces committed SCUs below 80% in first 6 months.

lina_cs: From CS perspective, migration support load will be medium-high. We should request a migration fee or include 20 hours of premium support in the deal. Also recommend a single-customer success plan with adoption milestone for Q1.

noah_sales: Updated offer proposal (v2): 35% off, net-45 (with 1.5% early pay), $15k migration fee, observability retention for 12 months at discounted add-on, 12mo term. That hits customer's ask partially and improves margin.

marta_finance: New numbers please.

noah_sales: New math:
- List: $480k
- 35% off => $168k discount => committed $312k
- Observability add-on after discount => +$20k
- Migration fee one-time $15k (recognized up front)
Estimated COGS still $120k. Margin ~ (312+15+20 - 120) / (312+15+20) ~ 64%.

approvals-bot: New approval ticket created: APPR-2025-248. Linked: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/APPR-2025-248

kevin_dealdesk: @jules_cfo we need CFO signoff since final discount is 35% (still above standard 30%). Can you approve APPR-2025-248? Docs: sales deck + margin calc attached in ticket.

jules_cfo: Reviewed. Conditional approval provided: approve 35% discount + net-45 on the following conditions —
- migration fee of $15k must be on SOW and non-refundable if migration starts
- early-pay 1.5% included
- include discount clawback clause for first 6 months
- Finance to confirm deferred revenue accounting prior to contract signing
I'll sign once legal confirms modified T&C language. :thumbsup:

sam_legal: I'll update the SOW and add clawback clause. Will confirm no bespoke indemnity. ETA 24 hours.

ada_fp&a: Finance confirmed: deferred revenue treatment acceptable; cashflow exposure logged. Will update Salesforce with special-terms flag after contract executed.

lina_cs: We'll schedule migration kickoff for earliest May to meet June migration ask if contract signed by end of April.

noah_sales: Thanks team. I'll present updated SOW/quote to Solaris procurement and link APPR-2025-248. Will ping once customer signs.

marta_finance: Marking this thread for records. Please paste signed contract here when available. :eyes:

noah_sales: Will do. Closing here for now.
